description: This file defines the ProductRelationshipService interface, which specifies methods for managing product relationships such as related, featured, grouped relationships, and their CRUD operations within the sales management system.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipService
classes.description: Java interface defining service methods for managing product relationships, including retrieval, creation, activation, deactivation, and grouping of product relationships.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProductRelationship entity.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product relationships filtered by store, product, type, and optionally language.

methods.name: listByProduct
methods.description: Returns all relationships associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves groups of product relationships acting as product groups.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Creates a new product group associated with a store.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves product relationships belonging to a specified group, optionally filtered by language.
